name: Mortgage Affordability Scorer
purpose: Estimates whether individual mortgage applicants can afford repayments, using their income, existing debts and repayment history to produce an approval recommendation.

name: Video Interview Ranker
purpose: Analyses recorded video interviews of job candidates and ranks them for recruiters based on speech and answer content.

name: Phone Assistant
purpose: Answers incoming customer phone calls automatically, handling routine questions about opening hours and account balances.

name: Inventory Demand Forecaster
purpose: Forecasts weekly product demand for warehouse stock planning using historical sales and seasonality.

name: Elderly Product Targeting Engine
purpose: Identifies customers over 75 and tailors sales messages to exploit their age-related difficulty understanding complex financial products, in order to sell them expensive products.

name: Coursework Auto-Grader
purpose: Automatically grades university students' written coursework and records the result as part of their assessed learning outcomes.

name: Audiobook Voice Generator
purpose: Generates realistic synthetic narration audio from book text for publishers to distribute as audiobooks.

name: Telecom Churn Predictor
purpose: Predicts which telecom subscribers are likely to cancel their plan so the retention team can plan offers.

name: Classroom Emotion Monitor
purpose: Uses classroom cameras to infer pupils' emotions such as boredom or frustration and reports them to teachers.

name: Credit Limit Assigner
purpose: Assigns an initial credit limit to each individual cardholder based on their financial profile and spending behaviour.
